assumptions: Synthetic positions, headings and timing for testing the player.
No COLREG responsibilities or recommended actions are assigned.
Simplified motion; hydrodynamics and stopping distances are not simulated.
title: A change of course
summary: Inspect an authored turn, compare camera views and replay each phase of the movement.

steps.title: Before the turn
steps.body: Atlas begins on a straight track. Nord follows a separate fixed track. This scene demonstrates the animation system only; it does not establish COLREG duties.

steps.title: An authored course change
steps.body: Atlas starts the scripted turn. Its heading and position are sampled from the same timeline. Use 0.5× speed to examine the transition.

steps.title: Inspect the movement
steps.body: Switch between the overhead and bridge views. Heading arrows show orientation; the visible track records movement up to the current time.

steps.title: Replay and compare
steps.body: The turn is complete. Jump between the steps or scrub backwards to review. Once the book arrives, reviewed scenario data will replace these synthetic examples.
